description: The Coca-Cola Company is a total beverage company that owns or licenses and markets numerous nonalcoholic beverage brands sold in more than 200 countries and territories. Its portfolio spans sparkling soft drinks (Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta), water, sports, coffee and tea (Dasani, Powerade, Costa, smartwater), and juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverages (Minute Maid, fairlife, innocent, Simply). The Company makes most of its money by selling concentrates and syrups to a global network of independent bottling partners, which manufacture, package and distribute finished beverages, while also operating consolidated bottling operations through its Bottling Investments segment. The Coca-Cola system sold 33.8 billion unit cases of beverages in 2025 across five operating segments: EMEA, Latin America, North America, Asia Pacific and Bottling Investments.
